terms.title: Quotation and Validity
points: The quotation will be valid till 15 Days.

terms.title: Purchase Order (PO) Issuance
points: The Purchase Order (PO) must be issued within Quotation validity period to the Dealer authorised by the Company.
Copy of the PO must be sent to the Company as well without fail within the same timeline as mentioned above.
PO Email or correspondence must be sent from your Authorised Person's email ID only.

terms.title: Price Validity
points: The Agreed Rate will be valid for a maximum period of 30 Days from date of issuance of Purchase Order.

terms.title: Delivery Schedule
points: Delivery schedule must be given within price validity period as mentioned above.
It means order must be scheduled for delivery within 30 Days from the date of the Purchase order.

terms.title: Change of Delivery Schedule
points: Delivery can be rescheduled at 15 days prior notice, in writing, before original schedule date.
The revised schedule date, if any, must fall within price validity period.

terms.title: Terms of Supply of Goods
points: Goods will be supplied by the Dealer (AD/MD/RSD/RD/ASD) Authorised by the Company.

terms.title: Terms of Payment
points: 100% advance payment is must with Purchase Order (PO).
Payment must be made to the concerned Dealer within stipulated timeline to ensure uninterrupted supply.

terms.title: Communication
points: All Communication/Correspondence must be made in writing. Verbal commitments are not admissible.

terms.title: Warranty
points: All products are covered under standard warranty policy of the company applicable for the product.
Warranty certificate can be obtained from our website www.jaquar.com after registration.

terms.title: Additional Terms Applicable for Shower Enclosure, only
points: Minimum 20 Days from receipt of PO if quantity >= 75 Units.
Minimum 25 Days from receipt of PO if quantity < 75 Units.
No modification / Cancellation possible after PO is given.
Company's authorized service provider will install the product.
Lift Service is to be provided or made available for use to carry product to installation site.
Suitable electrical connection is to be provided for efficient working of power tools required for installation.
